```{r}
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}
T <- read.csv("out_to_preva_lme_anal.csv")

T$hz <- as.numeric(str_extract(T$cond, "(?<=T)\\d+(?=_)"))
T$torder <- as.numeric(str_extract(T$cond, "(?<=_)\\d+"))

N2_data <- aggregate(trial_amount ~ sub + hz + torder, T[T$sov == "N2",], sum)
Kc_raw <- aggregate(trial_amount ~ sub + hz + torder, T[T$sov == "N2EliwJKc",], sum)
Ss_raw <- aggregate(trial_amount ~ sub + hz + torder, T[T$sov == "N2EliwJSs",], sum)

Kc_data <- merge(Kc_raw, N2_data, by = c("sub", "hz", "torder"), suffixes = c("_Kc", "_N2"))
Kc_data$proportion <- Kc_data$trial_amount_Kc / Kc_data$trial_amount_N2

Ss_data <- merge(Ss_raw, N2_data, by = c("sub", "hz", "torder"), suffixes = c("_Ss", "_N2"))
Ss_data$proportion <- Ss_data$trial_amount_Ss / Ss_data$trial_amount_N2


##############################################
# Adjust curr_data and run the following sections. Take figs with a grain of salt, as it is very heavily chat induced
##############################################
curr_data = Ss_data ## Kc_data, Ss_data 


```

```{r}
###### MLE analysis

# Create output file
dataset_name <- if(identical(curr_data, Ss_data)) "Ss_data" else "Kc_data"
output_file <- paste0("lme_analysis_results_", dataset_name, ".txt")
sink(output_file)  # Redirect output to file

curr_data$torder_ord <- ordered(curr_data$torder)
curr_data$hz_ord <- ordered(curr_data$hz)

# Calculate BF using BIC differences
BF <- function(bic1, bic2) {
    exp((bic1 - bic2)/2)
}

cat("=== LINEAR MIXED-EFFECTS MODEL ANALYSIS RESULTS ===\n")
cat("Date:", format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), "\n\n")
cat("=== MODEL COMPARISONS ===\n\n")

# Compare models to test interaction significance
model_null            <- lmer(proportion ~ (1|sub), data = curr_data)
model_hz              <- lmer(proportion ~ hz + (1|sub), data = curr_data)
model_torder          <- lmer(proportion ~ torder + (1|sub), data = curr_data)
model_addative        <- lmer(proportion ~ torder + hz + (1|sub), data = curr_data)
model_interaction     <- lmer(proportion ~ torder * hz + (1|sub), data = curr_data)


cat("1. NULL vs HZ MODEL:\n")
print(anova(model_null, model_hz))
cat("BF =", BF(BIC(model_null), BIC(model_hz)), "\n")
cat("\n")

cat("2. NULL vs TORDER MODEL:\n")
print(anova(model_null, model_torder))
cat("BF =", BF(BIC(model_null), BIC(model_torder)), "\n")
cat("\n")

cat("3. HZ vs ADDITIVE MODEL:\n")
print(anova(model_hz, model_addative))
cat("BF =", BF(BIC(model_hz), BIC(model_addative)), "\n")
cat("\n")

cat("4. TORDER vs ADDITIVE MODEL:\n")
print(anova(model_torder, model_addative))
cat("BF =", BF(BIC(model_torder), BIC(model_addative)), "\n")
cat("\n")

cat("5. ADDITIVE vs INTERACTION MODEL:\n")
print(anova(model_addative, model_interaction))
cat("BF =", BF(BIC(model_addative), BIC(model_interaction)), "\n")
cat("\n")

# Test interaction
cat("=== FINAL INTERACTION MODEL SUMMARY ===\n")
print(summary(model_interaction))
cat("\n")

cat("=== TYPE III ANOVA TABLE ===\n")
print(anova(model_interaction))
cat("\n")

# Get BIC for all models
all_models_BIC <- data.frame(
  Model = c("Null", "Hz only", "Torder only", "Additive", "Interaction"),
  AIC = c(AIC(model_null), AIC(model_hz), AIC(model_torder), AIC(model_addative), AIC(model_interaction)),
  BIC = c(BIC(model_null), BIC(model_hz), BIC(model_torder), BIC(model_addative), BIC(model_interaction)),
  LogLik = c(logLik(model_null), logLik(model_hz), logLik(model_torder), logLik(model_addative), logLik(model_interaction)),
  df = c(attr(logLik(model_null), "df"), 
         attr(logLik(model_hz), "df"), 
         attr(logLik(model_torder), "df"), 
         attr(logLik(model_addative), "df"), 
         attr(logLik(model_interaction), "df"))
)

print(all_models_BIC)

# Calculate BIC differences relative to null model
all_models_BIC$Delta_BIC_from_null <- all_models_BIC$BIC - BIC(model_null)

# Calculate BIC differences relative to best model
best_BIC <- min(all_models_BIC$BIC)
all_models_BIC$Delta_BIC_from_best <- all_models_BIC$BIC - best_BIC

# Calculate Bayes Factors
null_bic <- BIC(model_null)

# BF relative to null model (BF > 1 means evidence against null)
all_models_BIC$BF_vs_null <- sapply(all_models_BIC$BIC, function(x) BF(null_bic, x))

# BF relative to best model (BF > 1 means evidence against the model compared to best)
all_models_BIC$BF_vs_best <- sapply(all_models_BIC$BIC, function(x) BF(best_BIC, x))

print(all_models_BIC)

# Individual BIC values for quick reference
cat("\nIndividual BIC values:\n")
cat("Null model:", BIC(model_null), "\n")
cat("Hz model:", BIC(model_hz), "\n") 
cat("Torder model:", BIC(model_torder), "\n")
cat("Additive model:", BIC(model_addative), "\n")
cat("Interaction model:", BIC(model_interaction), "\n")

# Best model
best_model_index <- which.min(all_models_BIC$BIC)
cat("\nBest model (lowest BIC):", all_models_BIC$Model[best_model_index], 
    "with BIC =", all_models_BIC$BIC[best_model_index], "\n")

# Bayes Factor interpretations
cat("\n=== BAYES FACTOR ANALYSIS ===\n\n")

cat("BAYES FACTORS vs NULL MODEL:\n")
for(i in 1:nrow(all_models_BIC)) {
  bf_val <- all_models_BIC$BF_vs_null[i]
  model_name <- all_models_BIC$Model[i]
  
  # Interpretation based on Kass & Raftery (1995) criteria
  if(bf_val < 1) {
    evidence <- "Evidence against"
  } else if(bf_val >= 1 & bf_val < 3) {
    evidence <- "Barely worth mentioning evidence for"
  } else if(bf_val >= 3 & bf_val < 10) {
    evidence <- "Positive evidence for"
  } else if(bf_val >= 10 & bf_val < 30) {
    evidence <- "Strong evidence for"
  } else if(bf_val >= 30 & bf_val < 100) {
    evidence <- "Very strong evidence for"
  } else {
    evidence <- "Decisive evidence for"
  }
  
  cat(sprintf("%-15s: BF = %8.2f (%s)\n", model_name, bf_val, evidence))
}

cat("\nBAYES FACTORS vs BEST MODEL:\n")
best_model_name <- all_models_BIC$Model[best_model_index]
cat("Best model:", best_model_name, "\n")

for(i in 1:nrow(all_models_BIC)) {
  if(i != best_model_index) {
    bf_val <- all_models_BIC$BF_vs_best[i]
    model_name <- all_models_BIC$Model[i]
    
    # Interpretation
    if(bf_val < 1) {
      evidence <- "Evidence against best model"
    } else if(bf_val >= 1 & bf_val < 3) {
      evidence <- "Barely worth mentioning evidence against"
    } else if(bf_val >= 3 & bf_val < 10) {
      evidence <- "Positive evidence against"
    } else if(bf_val >= 10 & bf_val < 30) {
      evidence <- "Strong evidence against"
    } else if(bf_val >= 30 & bf_val < 100) {
      evidence <- "Very strong evidence against"
    } else {
      evidence <- "Decisive evidence against"
    }
    
    cat(sprintf("%-15s: BF = %8.2f (%s)\n", model_name, bf_val, evidence))
  }
}

# Key pairwise comparisons
cat("\n=== KEY MODEL COMPARISONS ===\n")

# Hz vs Null
bf_hz_null <- BF(BIC(model_null), BIC(model_hz))
cat(sprintf("Hz vs Null:        BF = %8.2f\n", bf_hz_null))

# Torder vs Null  
bf_torder_null <- BF(BIC(model_null), BIC(model_torder))
cat(sprintf("Torder vs Null:    BF = %8.2f\n", bf_torder_null))

# Additive vs Hz only
bf_add_hz <- BF(BIC(model_hz), BIC(model_addative))
cat(sprintf("Additive vs Hz:    BF = %8.2f\n", bf_add_hz))

# Additive vs Torder only
bf_add_torder <- BF(BIC(model_torder), BIC(model_addative))
cat(sprintf("Additive vs Torder: BF = %8.2f\n", bf_add_torder))

# Interaction vs Additive
bf_int_add <- BF(BIC(model_addative), BIC(model_interaction))
cat(sprintf("Interaction vs Add: BF = %8.2f\n", bf_int_add))

# Post-hoc analysis
cat("\n=== POST-HOC ANALYSIS ===\n\n")

curr_data$torder_factor <- factor(curr_data$torder, levels = c(1, 2, 3, 4))
model_posthoc <- lmer(proportion ~ torder_factor * hz + (1|sub), data = curr_data)

# Get marginal means
emm_torder <- emmeans(model_posthoc, ~ torder_factor)
cat("ESTIMATED MARGINAL MEANS BY TORDER:\n")
print(emm_torder)
cat("\n")

# Get all pairwise comparisons WITHOUT FDR correction first
all_pairs_raw <- pairs(emm_torder, adjust = "none")
pairs_summary_raw <- summary(all_pairs_raw, infer = TRUE)

# Extract only the 3 consecutive comparisons
consecutive_indices <- c(1, 4, 6)  # T1-T2, T2-T3, T3-T4 from the pairs output
consecutive_only <- pairs_summary_raw[consecutive_indices, ]
consecutive_only$p.value.fdr <- p.adjust(consecutive_only$p.value, method = "fdr")

# Create table with consecutive comparison results
comparison_names <- c("T1_vs_T2", "T2_vs_T3", "T3_vs_T4")

consecutive_table <- data.frame(
  Comparison = comparison_names,
  Difference = round(consecutive_only$estimate, 4),
  SE = round(consecutive_only$SE, 4),
  t_ratio = round(consecutive_only$t.ratio, 2),
  df = consecutive_only$df,
  p_raw = sprintf("%.2e", consecutive_only$p.value),
  p_FDR_corrected = sprintf("%.2e", consecutive_only$p.value.fdr),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

cat("=== CONSECUTIVE COMPARISONS TABLE ===\n")
print(consecutive_table, row.names = FALSE)
cat("\n")

# Clean table for manuscript
manuscript_table <- data.frame(
  Comparison = comparison_names,
  `Mean Difference` = sprintf("%.4f", consecutive_only$estimate),
  `95% CI` = paste0("[", sprintf("%.4f", consecutive_only$lower.CL), ", ", 
                    sprintf("%.4f", consecutive_only$upper.CL), "]"),
  `t` = sprintf("%.2f", consecutive_only$t.ratio),
  `p (FDR-corrected)` = sprintf("%.2e", consecutive_only$p.value.fdr),
  check.names = FALSE
)

cat("=== MANUSCRIPT-READY TABLE ===\n")
print(manuscript_table, row.names = FALSE)
cat("\n")


# Extract key statistics for manuscript
cat("=== KEY STATISTICS FOR MANUSCRIPT ===\n")
model_summary <- summary(model_interaction)
anova_summary <- anova(model_interaction)

cat("MAIN EFFECTS:\n")
cat("- Torder: F(", anova_summary$NumDF[1], ",", round(anova_summary$DenDF[1]), ") = ", 
    round(anova_summary$`F value`[1], 2), ", p = ", 
    ifelse(anova_summary$`Pr(>F)`[1] < 0.001, 
           sprintf("%.2e", anova_summary$`Pr(>F)`[1]), 
           round(anova_summary$`Pr(>F)`[1], 3)), "\n")

cat("  Beta = ", sprintf("%.3e", model_summary$coefficients[2, 1]), 
    ", t = ", round(model_summary$coefficients[2, 4], 2),
    ", p = ", sprintf("%.2e", model_summary$coefficients[2, 5]), "\n")

cat("- Hz: F(", anova_summary$NumDF[2], ",", round(anova_summary$DenDF[2]), ") = ", 
    round(anova_summary$`F value`[2], 2), ", p = ", 
    ifelse(anova_summary$`Pr(>F)`[2] < 0.001, 
           sprintf("%.2e", anova_summary$`Pr(>F)`[2]), 
           round(anova_summary$`Pr(>F)`[2], 3)), "\n")

cat("  Beta = ", sprintf("%.3e", model_summary$coefficients[3, 1]), 
    ", t = ", round(model_summary$coefficients[3, 4], 2),
    ", p = ", sprintf("%.2e", model_summary$coefficients[3, 5]), "\n")

cat("INTERACTION:\n")
cat("- Torder x Hz: F(", anova_summary$NumDF[3], ",", round(anova_summary$DenDF[3]), ") = ", 
    round(anova_summary$`F value`[3], 2), ", p = ", 
    ifelse(anova_summary$`Pr(>F)`[3] < 0.001, 
           sprintf("%.2e", anova_summary$`Pr(>F)`[3]), 
           round(anova_summary$`Pr(>F)`[3], 3)), "\n")

cat("  Beta = ", sprintf("%.3e", model_summary$coefficients[4, 1]), 
    ", t = ", round(model_summary$coefficients[4, 4], 2),
    ", p = ", sprintf("%.2e", model_summary$coefficients[4, 5]), "\n")

cat("\n=== BAYES FACTOR SUMMARY FOR MANUSCRIPT ===\n")
cat("Model selection based on BIC and Bayes Factors:\n")
cat("- Best model:", best_model_name, "(lowest BIC)\n")
cat("- Evidence for best model vs null: BF =", all_models_BIC$BF_vs_null[best_model_index], "\n")

if(best_model_name != "Interaction") {
  int_index <- which(all_models_BIC$Model == "Interaction")
  cat("- Evidence against interaction model: BF =", all_models_BIC$BF_vs_best[int_index], "\n")
}

cat("\n=== ANALYSIS COMPLETE ===\n")
cat("Results saved to:", output_file, "\n")

# Close the sink to return output to console
sink()

# Print confirmation message to console
cat("Analysis complete! Results saved to:", output_file, "\n")
cat("File location:", file.path(getwd(), output_file), "\n")
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

# Create boxplots with mustard color gradient

# Convert proportion to percentage
curr_data$percentage <- curr_data$proportion * 100
curr_data$torder_factor <- factor(curr_data$torder, levels = c(1, 2, 3, 4), 
                                 labels = c("T1", "T2", "T3", "T4"))

mustard_colors <- c("#FFF8DC", "#F0E68C", "#DAA520", "#B8860B")

# Create the boxplot
p <- ggplot(curr_data, aes(x = torder_factor, y = percentage, fill = torder_factor)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.8, outlier.shape = NA) +
  
  # Add mean points
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", shape = 21, size = 3, 
               fill = "white", stroke = 1.5) +
  
  # Styling
  labs(title = paste("Sleep Event Prevalence Across Tone Repetitions -", dataset_name),
       x = "Tone Repetition",
       y = "% Trials with Events") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = mustard_colors, name = "Tone\nRepetition") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, face = "bold"),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10)) +
  ylim(0, 20)

# Print the plot
print(p)

# Save the plot
ggsave(paste0("boxplot_", dataset_name, ".svg"), 
       plot = p, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)

cat("Boxplot created and saved successfully!\n")
```

```{r}

# Function to add significance asterisks
add_sig <- function(p_val) {
  if (p_val < 0.001) return("***")
  else if (p_val < 0.01) return("**") 
  else if (p_val < 0.05) return("*")
  else return("ns")
}
```

```{r}


###### MLE analysis plotting ######

# Create prediction data for interaction plots
hz_range_seq <- seq(min(curr_data$hz), max(curr_data$hz), length.out = 10)
torder_range_seq <- seq(min(curr_data$torder), max(curr_data$torder), length.out = 50)

pred_data_full <- expand.grid(
  torder = torder_range_seq,
  hz = hz_range_seq,
  sub = curr_data$sub[1]
)
pred_data_full$predicted <- predict(model_interaction, pred_data_full, re.form = NA)

# Plot 1: Interaction lines across all Hz values
plot_interaction_lines <- ggplot(pred_data_full, aes(x = torder, y = predicted, color = hz)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = hz), size = 1.2) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(name = "Hz") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(min(pred_data_full$predicted)*0.98, max(pred_data_full$predicted)*1.02)) +
  labs(title = "Torder × Hz Interaction Across All Hz Values",
       x = "Torder", 
       y = "Predicted Proportion",
       subtitle = paste("Interaction p =", round(anova(model_addative, model_interaction)$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2], 4))) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"))

print(plot_interaction_lines)

# Plot 2: 2D heatmap showing interaction surface
pred_grid_full <- expand.grid(
  torder = seq(min(curr_data$torder), max(curr_data$torder), length.out = 50),
  hz = seq(min(curr_data$hz), max(curr_data$hz), length.out = 50),
  sub = curr_data$sub[1]
)
pred_grid_full$predicted <- predict(model_interaction, pred_grid_full, re.form = NA)

plot_heatmap <- ggplot(pred_grid_full, aes(x = torder, y = hz, fill = predicted)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "Proportion") +
  geom_contour(aes(z = predicted), color = "white", alpha = 0.5, size = 0.5) +
  labs(title = "Interaction Surface: All Hz × Torder Combinations",
       x = "Torder", y = "Hz") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"))

print(plot_heatmap)

# Plot 3: Raw data points colored by Hz with overall trend
plot_raw_data <- ggplot(curr_data, aes(x = torder, y = proportion, color = hz)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black", size = 1.5) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(name = "Hz") +
  labs(title = "Raw Data: All Hz Values with Overall Trend",
       x = "Torder", 
       y = "Observed Proportion",
       subtitle = "Black line shows overall linear trend") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"))

print(plot_raw_data)

# Plot 4: Slope of torder effect across Hz values
hz_seq <- seq(min(curr_data$hz), max(curr_data$hz), length.out = 20)
slopes_data_full <- data.frame()

for(hz_val in hz_seq) {
  window_size <- (max(curr_data$hz) - min(curr_data$hz)) / 20
  temp_data <- curr_data[abs(curr_data$hz - hz_val) <= window_size, ]
  
  if(nrow(temp_data) > 5) {
    slope_model <- lm(proportion ~ torder, data = temp_data)
    slopes_data_full <- rbind(slopes_data_full, data.frame(
      hz = hz_val,
      slope = coef(slope_model)[2],
      slope_se = summary(slope_model)$coefficients[2,2],
      n_points = nrow(temp_data)
    ))
  }
}

plot_slopes <- ggplot(slopes_data_full, aes(x = hz, y = slope)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = n_points), color = "darkblue", alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = slope - 1.96*slope_se, ymax = slope + 1.96*slope_se), 
                width = 50, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "red", size = 1.5) +
  scale_size_continuous(name = "N points", range = c(2, 6)) +
  labs(title = "How Torder Effect Changes Across All Hz Values",
       x = "Hz", 
       y = "Slope of Torder Effect",
       subtitle = "Red line shows linear trend in slope changes") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"))

print(plot_slopes)

# Plot 5: Faceted plots by Hz (if manageable number)
unique_hz <- sort(unique(curr_data$hz))
if(length(unique_hz) <= 12) {
  plot_facets <- ggplot(curr_data, aes(x = torder, y = proportion)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 1.5) +

    facet_wrap(~hz, scales = "free_y",

    labs(title = "Torder Effect at Each Unique Hz Value",
         x = "Torder", 
         y = "Observed Proportion") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +

          plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"))
  
  print(plot_facets)
} else {
  cat("Too many unique Hz values (", length(unique_hz), ") for individual facets.\n")
  cat("Unique Hz values:", paste(unique_hz, collapse = ", "))
}

###### Bar plots with significance ######

model_summary <- summary(model_interaction)

# Plot 6: Fixed main effects (across ranges)
hz_range <- max(curr_data$hz) - min(curr_data$hz)
torder_range <- max(curr_data$torder) - min(curr_data$torder)

effects_range <- data.frame(
  Effect = c("Torder", "Hz"),
  Estimate_per_unit = model_summary$coefficients[2:3, 1],
  Range = c(torder_range, hz_range),
  Effect_across_range = c(
    model_summary$coefficients[2, 1] * torder_range,
    model_summary$coefficients[3, 1] * hz_range
  ),
  SE_across_range = c(
    model_summary$coefficients[2, 2] * torder_range,
    model_summary$coefficients[3, 2] * hz_range
  ),
  p_value = model_summary$coefficients[2:3, 5]
)

effects_range$significance <- sapply(effects_range$p_value, add_sig)
effects_range$CI_lower <- effects_range$Effect_across_range - 1.96 * effects_range$SE_across_range
effects_range$CI_upper <- effects_range$Effect_across_range + 1.96 * effects_range$SE_across_range

# Format p-values properly (avoid p=0)
effects_range$p_label <- ifelse(effects_range$p_value < 0.001, 
                               paste("p <", "0.001"), 
                               paste("p =", round(effects_range$p_value, 3)))

# Fix positioning for asterisks - use absolute positions
effects_range$y_pos_stars <- pmax(effects_range$CI_upper, effects_range$Effect_across_range) + 
                            0.02 * max(abs(effects_range$Effect_across_range))

# Calculate y-axis limits to include asterisks
y_min <- min(effects_range$CI_lower) * 1.1
y_max <- max(effects_range$y_pos_stars) * 1.2

plot_main_effects_fixed <- ggplot(effects_range, aes(x = Effect, y = Effect_across_range)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.7, width = 0.6) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = CI_lower, ymax = CI_upper), width = 0.2, size = 1) +
  geom_text(aes(label = significance, y = y_pos_stars), vjust = 0, size = 8) +
  geom_text(aes(label = p_label, y = CI_lower), vjust = 1.2, size = 4) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(y_min, y_max)) +
  labs(title = "Main Effects Across Variable Ranges",
       subtitle = paste("Torder range:", torder_range, "| Hz range:", hz_range),
       x = "Effect", y = "Effect Across Full Range") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"))

print(plot_main_effects_fixed)

# Plot 7: Standardized effects
curr_data_scaled <- curr_data
curr_data_scaled$torder_z <- scale(curr_data_scaled$torder)[,1]
curr_data_scaled$hz_z <- scale(curr_data_scaled$hz)[,1]

model_standardized <- lmer(proportion ~ torder_z * hz_z + (1|sub), data = curr_data_scaled)
model_std_summary <- summary(model_standardized)

std_effects <- data.frame(
  Effect = c("Torder (std)", "Hz (std)"),
  Estimate = model_std_summary$coefficients[2:3, 1],
  SE = model_std_summary$coefficients[2:3, 2],
  p_value = model_std_summary$coefficients[2:3, 5]
)
std_effects$significance <- sapply(std_effects$p_value, add_sig)
std_effects$CI_lower <- std_effects$Estimate - 1.96 * std_effects$SE
std_effects$CI_upper <- std_effects$Estimate + 1.96 * std_effects$SE

# Format p-values properly
std_effects$p_label <- ifelse(std_effects$p_value < 0.001, 
                             paste("p <", "0.001"), 
                             paste("p =", round(std_effects$p_value, 3)))

# Fix positioning and y-axis limits for standardized plot too
std_effects$y_pos_stars <- pmax(std_effects$CI_upper, std_effects$Estimate) + 
                          0.02 * max(abs(std_effects$Estimate))

y_min_std <- min(std_effects$CI_lower) * 1.1
y_max_std <- max(std_effects$y_pos_stars) * 1.2

plot_standardized_effects <- ggplot(std_effects, aes(x = Effect, y = Estimate)) +
  geom_col(fill = "darkgreen", alpha = 0.7, width = 0.6) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = CI_lower, ymax = CI_upper), width = 0.2, size = 1) +
  geom_text(aes(label = significance, y = y_pos_stars), vjust = 0, size = 8) +
  geom_text(aes(label = p_label, y = CI_lower), vjust = 1.2, size = 4) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(y_min_std, y_max_std)) +
  labs(title = "Standardized Main Effects",
       subtitle = "Effects in standard deviation units",
       x = "Effect", y = "Standardized Coefficient") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"))

print(plot_standardized_effects)

# Plot 8: Mean proportion by torder value
torder_means <- curr_data %>%
  group_by(torder) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_prop = mean(proportion),
    se_prop = sd(proportion)/sqrt(n()),
    n_obs = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Test if each torder differs significantly from grand mean
grand_mean <- mean(curr_data$proportion)
torder_means$t_stat <- (torder_means$mean_prop - grand_mean) / torder_means$se_prop
torder_means$p_value <- 2 * (1 - pt(abs(torder_means$t_stat), df = torder_means$n_obs - 1))
torder_means$significance <- sapply(torder_means$p_value, add_sig)
torder_means$sig_label <- ifelse(torder_means$significance == "ns", "", torder_means$significance)

plot_torder_means <- ggplot(torder_means, aes(x = factor(torder), y = mean_prop)) +
  geom_col(fill = "forestgreen", alpha = 0.7, width = 0.8) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_prop - 1.96*se_prop, ymax = mean_prop + 1.96*se_prop), 
                width = 0.2, size = 1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = grand_mean, linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.6, color = "red") +
  geom_text(aes(label = sig_label, y = mean_prop + 1.96*se_prop), vjust = -0.5, size = 5) +
  labs(title = "Mean Proportion by Torder Value",
       subtitle = "Dashed line = grand mean; asterisks = significantly different from grand mean",
       x = "Torder", y = "Mean Proportion") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

print(plot_torder_means)

# Plot 9: Mean proportion by Hz value
hz_means <- curr_data %>%
  group_by(hz) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_prop = mean(proportion),
    se_prop = sd(proportion)/sqrt(n()),
    n_obs = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Test if each hz differs significantly from grand mean
hz_means$t_stat <- (hz_means$mean_prop - grand_mean) / hz_means$se_prop
hz_means$p_value <- 2 * (1 - pt(abs(hz_means$t_stat), df = hz_means$n_obs - 1))
hz_means$significance <- sapply(hz_means$p_value, add_sig)
hz_means$sig_label <- ifelse(hz_means$significance == "ns", "", hz_means$significance)

plot_hz_means <- ggplot(hz_means, aes(x = factor(hz), y = mean_prop)) +
  geom_col(fill = "orange", alpha = 0.7, width = 0.8) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_prop - 1.96*se_prop, ymax = mean_prop + 1.96*se_prop), 
                width = 0.2, size = 1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = grand_mean, linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.6, color = "red") +
  geom_text(aes(label = sig_label, y = mean_prop + 1.96*se_prop), vjust = -0.5, size = 5) +
  labs(title = "Mean Proportion by Hz Value",
       subtitle = "Dashed line = grand mean; asterisks = significantly different from grand mean",
       x = "Hz", y = "Mean Proportion") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

print(plot_hz_means)

# Plot 10: Interaction bars (remove hardcoded asterisks for now)
interaction_means <- curr_data %>%
  group_by(hz, torder) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_prop = mean(proportion),
    se_prop = sd(proportion)/sqrt(n()),
    n_obs = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(n_obs >= 3)  # Only combinations with sufficient data

plot_interaction_bars <- ggplot(interaction_means, aes(x = factor(torder), y = mean_prop, fill = factor(hz))) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge", alpha = 0.8, width = 0.8) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_prop - 1.96*se_prop, ymax = mean_prop + 1.96*se_prop), 
                position = position_dodge(0.8), width = 0.2, size = 1) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(name = "Hz") +
  labs(title = "Interaction: Mean Proportion by Hz × Torder",
       subtitle = "Individual condition means (no significance testing)",
       x = "Torder", y = "Mean Proportion") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "bottom")

print(plot_interaction_bars)

# Plot 11: Interaction effect significance
interaction_effect <- data.frame(
  Effect = "Torder × Hz",
  Estimate = model_summary$coefficients[4, 1],
  SE = model_summary$coefficients[4, 2],
  p_value = model_summary$coefficients[4, 5]
)
interaction_effect$significance <- sapply(interaction_effect$p_value, add_sig)
interaction_effect$CI_lower <- interaction_effect$Estimate - 1.96 * interaction_effect$SE
interaction_effect$CI_upper <- interaction_effect$Estimate + 1.96 * interaction_effect$SE

# Format p-value properly
interaction_effect$p_label <- ifelse(interaction_effect$p_value < 0.001, 
                                   paste("p <", "0.001"), 
                                   paste("p =", round(interaction_effect$p_value, 3)))

# Fix positioning and y-axis limits for interaction plot too
interaction_effect$y_pos_stars <- pmax(interaction_effect$CI_upper, interaction_effect$Estimate) + 
                                  0.02 * max(abs(interaction_effect$Estimate))

y_min_int <- min(interaction_effect$CI_lower) * 1.1
y_max_int <- max(interaction_effect$y_pos_stars) * 1.2

plot_interaction_significance <- ggplot(interaction_effect, aes(x = Effect, y = Estimate)) +
  geom_col(fill = "darkred", alpha = 0.7, width = 0.4) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = CI_lower, ymax = CI_upper), width = 0.1, size = 1) +
  geom_text(aes(label = significance, y = y_pos_stars), vjust = 0, size = 8) +
  geom_text(aes(label = p_label, y = CI_lower), vjust = 1.2, size = 4) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(y_min_int, y_max_int)) +
  labs(title = "Interaction Effect Significance",
       x = "", y = "Coefficient Estimate") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"))

print(plot_interaction_significance)
``` 
